about: Generated by tools/check.py --write from engines.json and every engines/<engine>/<version>/mods.json; the hook fails when it is stale. A consumer reads it at one commit of this repo (a pin, or the newest commit whose schema it reads and whose requires it meets) and records that commit; do not copy rows out of it. Gains, limits, conditions and evidence live in each mods.json at the same commit. id = engine/version/name.

tools.what: SRC DST: a copy of a single-file Quark W4A16 checkpoint with lm_head quantized like its linear layers (int4 symmetric, groups of 128, scale amax / 7.5, AWQ nibble order). Needs torch and safetensors. Not a patch.

mods.name: seq-rm-indexed
mods.title: seq_rm walks an index, not the cache
mods.why: upstream does it: llama.cpp #32380 (commit 21fa9c043f0e, in this base) removes a sequence's cells through its position index on every seq_rm, always on, so the switch chose between two equal paths; 83 lines for no gain on this base. Kept on 1.0.0, whose base lacks #32380
